quests.escrow_finding: This Supabase project has no escrow table. The only database record of Quest 001 escrows is quest_manifests.reward.funded_escrows on live manifest v2 (sha256 422f2c7b26708a5e398491d3ce7d1ec9624a1c378909e541db60725edbd561aa), which lists esc_0e020c419a0b (6.0) and esc_6cb8dcae818c (4.0). The published mesh ledger-789 snapshot records those two as funded at seq 603-604 on Thursday, November 12, 2026, 7:18:57 AM CT (receipts 8af9c6fa47c2e61a3977fc2dfdaa6c07ef2c565f601a681a11bcdf7c3ab3c5e7 and de6841f6da0ea18d29033d7074f0a6e1267da17273b426ccd202f632fabc4977; work_1ed874b4048f and work_e98175cd0823). Main's board and the November 19 morning brief claim those two were later cancelled and replaced by esc_1fa52cd08778 and esc_3a7dc9994f99 at 5.0 HHC each, with a live HHC service read at 7:06 AM CT on November 19 showing the 5.0 pair FUNDED and the 6/4 pair TERMINAL_REFUNDED. That later state is not in this database, not in the published ledger-789 snapshot, and could not be re-read: the HHC escrow service has no public endpoint and was not listening here. Finding for Dennis: the live official manifest still cites the 6/4 pair, while the board on main cites the 5.0 pair. This board follows the live official manifest and does not treat the 5.0 IDs as verified live escrows until the mesh ledger can be re-read or the manifest is updated. No escrow or manifest row was modified in this check.
